title: Minimum useful recoverability threshold tau
decision: Require the lower 95% confidence bound for held balanced accuracy to be at least 0.60
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Maximum acceptable source-to-held loss delta
decision: Require the upper 95% confidence bound for source minus held balanced accuracy to be at most 0.10
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Confirmatory support
decision: Require at least 3 held masters and 3 training masters per class in every outer split plus at least 2 source instruments per class and 3 paired held/source masters per class

title: Exploratory support
decision: Require at least 2 held masters and 2 training masters per class; source-instrument and paired limitations remain explicit but are not eligibility gates

title: P03 incomplete endpoint handling
decision: Retain all failures; use the common successfully evaluated endpoint estimate and a chance-performance sensitivity; prohibit a positive claim when that sensitivity reverses the result
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Primary preprocessing
decision: Use PP-U-MIN as primary with universal Savitzky-Golay and arPLS paired sensitivities
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Evaluation domain and class-support cell
decision: Define the evaluation domain as station by substrate family by held instrument and each class-support cell as that domain by analyte
must_precede: Any P13 support or outcome calculation

title: Independent and prediction units
decision: Treat physical master as independent and average technical-repeat probabilities within each master-substrate-instrument view for the primary prediction
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Classical estimator roles
decision: Use source-only C-SELECTED as primary; fixed RBF SVM as main sensitivity; PCA-LDA PLS-DA elastic-net logistic regression Random Forest and Extra Trees as secondary estimators
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Outer split reuse
decision: Reuse the five repeated four-fold P02 physical-master splits with held-instrument exclusion layered outside them

title: Interval method
decision: Use a 95% physical-master-clustered hierarchical bootstrap with 10000 resamples; use BCa where stable and percentile intervals otherwise
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Multiplicity
decision: Use a substrate-level intersection-union test for the portability claim and Holm correction for individual secondary cell claims
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes

title: Substrate granularity
decision: Use normalized substrate family for primary claims and retain substrate variants as exploratory strata
must_precede: Any P13 support or outcome calculation

title: Crossover support
decision: Classify analyte-specific two-substrate by two-instrument blocks with at least 3 masters as confirmatory 2 as exploratory and 1 as descriptive without interval claim

title: Recorded field-log handling
decision: Treat nonblank Y as recorded detection and blank N as specificity; exclude ambiguous M from definite binary analysis; retain missing as missing; report complete case plus best and worst missingness bounds

title: Portability outcome rule
decision: Require both held balanced-accuracy LCB95 at least 0.60 and source-minus-held loss UCB95 at most 0.10; assign one of five predeclared completion states
outcome_access_timing: Frozen after P03 outcomes and before P13 outcomes
